title: hook.py
question: Will this steel hook bend for good under a 3 kN sling, and what load pulls it open?

units.load: multiple of the load asked about

about: Frames play in order of t. The load goes on (t 0 to 1) and comes off (t 1 to 2) with the true stress strain curve and large deflection theory, then an elastic perfectly plastic copy on the same mesh is ramped to collapse (t from 2 on). values.load is the load multiple at each frame; the last frame is the mechanism, which moves much further than the frames before it.
